title: Garden from above
note: Start with H23 for the footprints and H24 for the descent towards the porch. H07 links the glasshouses and paths at an oblique.

title: Porch and kitchen beds
note: H25 gives the rebuilt elevation. H27 looks along the bed towards it. For the March 2024 no-dig sequence, use the earlier glazing in H28–H29 and the actual sequence H16–H18.

title: Between the greenhouses
note: H60 shows the two structures in one frame from their path junction. H33 shows the longer brick-based elevation by the blue shed. H01 and H13 record separate construction dates.

title: Inside the greenhouses
note: H35 looks down the paved aisle with raised bed walls. H38 looks into the smaller house with woodchip down the middle. H57 shows the potting bench from above.

title: Blue shed and workshop
note: The workshop entrance and blue shed face different ways. H40 approaches on the stepping stones, H41 looks across the workshop to the shed. H58–H59 connect the outside roof to the interior.

title: Beds, lawn and paths
note: H44 follows the long bed towards the glazed gable. H61 looks back across the beds to the workshop and blue shed. H43 records the bend in the slab path.

title: Front garden and poultry
note: H48 looks across the front planting to the hen housing. H52 gives the low reverse inside the run. H54 locates the compost bays against the wall. Use the separate bin register for fittings.

title: March aerial and return pass
note: A12–A13 show grass behind the shed. A17–A19 cover the last paths and the end bed. A02 looks the opposite way. Working Map 03 identifies the seven paved strips and hidden stretches.

title: Shed and paving
note: A55 looks down at the open threshold from the grass. A28 looks back across the paving from the butt. A49–A51 show the door, floor and roof from inside. A56 follows the grass towards the window wall.

title: Lengthwise and across the beds
note: A31 looks across seedling rows towards the open shed. A32 looks along the cane row towards the boundary. A35 supplies a low angle with the brick strip in the foreground.

title: Grass paths and neighbours
note: A36 and A54 look in opposite directions along the same grass strip. The metal hoops stand on the neighbour’s side. A39 looks back towards John’s green shed from the containers.

title: Winter and summer beds
note: A42 shows the shed beyond low winter covers. A43 shows how much the leeks and netting screen at crop height in August. Use the plan to keep the bed and camera on the same side.

title: Reserved comparison angles
note: Use H09 and A03 as independent checks on an interpretation of the respective site. Keep them separate when choosing image-generation inputs.
